title: Mailing Invoices Under 1,000 a Month in Canada
description: Below Canada Post's 1,000-letter discount, how a small business can mail invoices and statements: by hand, with a mail service, or from billing software.
answer: Under 1,000 letters a month you miss Canada Post's bulk discount, so each letter costs at least a $1.24 stamp however it goes. You can print and post them yourself, use a print-and-mail service, or send them by API from your billing system, where a one-page letter falls as low as $1.69 all in.

sections.h2: Why the bulk discount does not help you

blocks.p: Canada Post's volume discount on letters begins above 1,000 items, and on a standard letter it saves about a cent against a booklet stamp. See [Canada Post letter discounts](/blog/canada-post-bulk-letter-discount). Under that volume, postage is the same $1.24 whichever route you take, so the real choice is what to do about the printing, folding, stuffing and posting.

rows: Paper, envelope, toner and your time
$2.25 for a one-page letter (fee, envelope, printing)
$1.24 on the first letter, falling to $0.45 by the 100th

blocks.p: Prices are for a one-page black-and-white letter in a #10 envelope with one stamp. On the website that is $3.49 in total; by API the first letter is $2.48 and a steady sender reaches $1.69 from the 100th letter in any 30 days. Postage is passed through at cost.
Totals include postage. The API discount counts letters over a rolling 30 days, so the average falls as your volume rises.

ul: Check that the letters really must be paper. Some customers accept email, which costs nothing.
Decide what happens to returned mail and wrong addresses. Put a return address on every letter.
Keep a record of what went to whom and when. Statements for a dispute need a date; see [how to prove you mailed a letter](/blog/proof-of-mailing-letter-canada).
Confirm the address format your billing system stores, including a full six-character postal code.

sections.h2: Sending them from your billing system

blocks.p: If your invoices are generated by software, the cleanest way is to send each one by API with an idempotency key, so a retry cannot post a second copy. See [the volume pricing calculator](/blog/api-volume-pricing) and [sending a letter with an API](/blog/send-a-letter-with-an-api-canada).
